content_html:
watched #Darbar : though many actors have yried to replicate his style and grace….though he himself has done in zillions of times it always a treat to watch Thalivaaa’s Style!!! and in Darbaar he once again proved that he is the One and only One Style Icon…..and when Rajini’s style meets Anirudh’s BGM then only sky is the limit!!!!!

Unfortunately Darbar’s postive ends there!!!! was it really Written and Directed by Murgadoos….Man how could he make a movie with such an outdated things 😦 surely he has lost form after Spyder ( though I liked it for the different concept)…..but still how can he direct a scene where the backdrop shows that Father has been killed some 27 Years back and in current date a 4 – 5 years old kid is kiising his photo and saying miss you dad _/_

except above there is nothing much to say about remaining crafts…..Though BGM has been great the songs have been equally bad!!!

Fans of Rajini’s style may like some parts of the movie…and fans of Murgadoos, better to stay away from this!!!!

surely Rajini must retire as none of the current lot are utilizing his screen presence fully to create an impact like Narasimha 😦
